full_prompt_en: A square cinematic sky study concentrates entirely on the towering structure of a thunderstorm. A dark navy upper atmosphere forms a nearly flat, heavy ceiling across the top quarter. Beneath it, dense cumulonimbus towers boil upward from an expansive cloud sea, their rounded lobes compressed together in overlapping layers. The main tower rises left of center and seems lit from within by an intense warm flash; pale gold and ivory light threads through gaps between charcoal cloud masses and traces their ragged rims. A smaller, cooler blue-gray tower stands to the right, while the foreground is packed with rolling near-black cloud tops that conceal any land or horizon. Thin horizontal strata near the upper edge flatten the sky above the violent central cluster. The light is localized and uneven: bright cream edges flare around interior openings, then fall rapidly into brown-black and slate-blue shadow. This gives each billow a sculptural, damp, weighty surface, with soft vaporous boundaries beside much sharper illuminated creases. The rendering resembles a highly detailed atmospheric photograph with subtle cinematic grading, preserving granular cloud texture rather than outlining every shape. Warm storm light remains a minority of the frame, surrounded by a large field of cold midnight blue. There are no people, buildings, or readable words; scale comes from the stacked masses alone. The image as a whole feels suspended just before a violent release, balancing broad dark stillness with a concentrated, restless core of light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感天空图像完全聚焦于高耸雷暴的结构。深海军蓝的大气在上方四分之一处形成近乎平直、沉重的顶盖。其下，密集积雨云塔从宽阔云海里翻涌升起，圆凸云团彼此挤压并重叠。主云塔位于中央偏左，仿佛被强烈暖色闪光从内部照亮；淡金与象牙白光穿过炭灰云体间的缝隙，勾出参差边缘。右侧立着一座较小、较冷的蓝灰云塔，前景则塞满滚动的近黑色云顶，遮住一切陆地和地平线。上缘附近的细横层让剧烈中央云团上方的天空显得平坦。光局部而不均：明亮乳白边缘在内部开口周围迸出，随即迅速跌入棕黑与石板蓝阴影。这使每片云鼓起的表面具有雕塑般潮湿沉重的质地，柔软蒸汽边界与更清晰的受光褶皱并存。渲染近似细节丰富的大气摄影，带微妙电影调色，保留云的颗粒质感而不逐一勾线。暖色风暴光只占画面少数，周围是大片冷午夜蓝。没有人物、建筑或可读文字；尺度完全来自叠压云体。整幅图像像悬在猛烈释放前一刻，以广阔深暗的静止衬托集中而不安的发光核心。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic atmospheric realism treats layered cloud volume as the whole composition. A broad navy-black upper field presses down on crowded charcoal and slate billows, while a limited ivory-gold inner glow cuts through fissures and frayed rims. Rounded masses overlap in dense depth, alternately vapor-soft at their outer edges and sharply creased where light catches them. Fine granular texture keeps the surface photographic and substantial. The warm highlights occupy a small, irregular center against much larger cool darkness, producing storm tension without hard graphic outlines. Horizontal upper strata contrast with turbulent piled forms below; luminous passages fade rapidly into deep shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感大气写实把层层云体当作整幅构图。宽阔海军蓝黑上层压住拥挤的炭灰与石板色云团，少量象牙金色内光穿过裂隙与破碎边缘。圆鼓体块密集重叠，外缘有时如蒸汽般柔软，受光处却留下锐利褶皱。细密颗粒质感让表面有摄影般的重量。暖色高光仅占不规则的小块中心，面对更大面积冷暗，靠明暗而非生硬图形轮廓形成雷暴张力。上方横向云层与下方翻涌叠起的形体相对，发光通道迅速没入深影。
theme_en: An immense thundercloud illuminated from within over a dark cloud sea
theme_zh: 巨大雷暴云在幽暗云海之上从内部发亮
name: Thunderstorm
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
